selected_reads.title: ClaimReceipt: Verifying Evidence Sufficiency and Coverage in Agent Evaluations
selected_reads.bounded_prior: Sufficiency is claim-relative; absent required evidence must reject or abstain; byte integrity, semantic sufficiency, experiment coverage, and external truth are separate layers; its evidence is one testbed with designed faults and no independent second implementation.

selected_reads.title: DNative-Twin: Decision Graphs and Digital Twins for Reconstructable Agentic Decisions
selected_reads.bounded_prior: Traceability, validity, and contextual applicability are distinct; locating a structural change does not determine its governance effect; unresolved is required when evidence cannot support classification; results are bounded to reported enterprise overlays and controlled injections.

selected_reads.title: Rules Before Oracles: Auditable, User-Configurable Argument Selection for Deliberative Polling
selected_reads.bounded_prior: Freeze admissibility criteria before selecting a rule and use multiple instruments because coverage alone can mislead; domain findings concern a simulated civic-poll model and do not establish research-agent efficacy.

selected_reads.title: DEMM-Bench: A Cross-Regime Benchmark for Agent-Runtime Governance-Evidence Sufficiency
selected_reads.bounded_prior: Task success and decision-record sufficiency are independent measurement objects; strict property-level labels, overclaim, underclaim, and gap localization avoid container-presence claims; evidence is an initial synthetic construction-oracle package with weak baselines and bounded regimes.

not_selected_for_claims: All other retrieval hits remain discovery-only and support no claim.
design_consequences: Score route exactness only as a manipulation check.
Define sufficiency relative to a frozen decision claim and hidden required-property manifest.
Return INCONCLUSIVE when required evidence, a unique choice oracle, or applicability is unresolved.
Keep source version, validity, scope/precondition applicability, alternatives, conflict state, falsifier, next experiment, and stop rule in the decision packet.
Require an independent end-to-end task outcome for confirmatory success; packet presence is not the outcome.
Report over-routing, under-routing, overclaim, underclaim, task success, and resource use separately.
